title: A head-only provider's supporting record holds no reason, so the law stays unestablished(missing) with the same key and binding as without it, and an approve line answers nothing

assert.why: A.5.1.3 [D9]: a record of a provider the base does not declare never establishes and holds no reason; A.5.4.3: so the reason is missing, not producer-changed or weak; introduced since Req meets Δcode (A.7.3.3); binding without producer-change additions (A.7.2.2)
A.7.6.5: reason missing has no answer discharger
A.5.2.13: bunTest declares no identity, so no E-provider-missing
